description: Builds a real, complete website preview for a small business from a one-sentence description (optionally its name and city), using AI Site Builder (sitebuilder.adcreator-ai.com). Returns a link to the live preview. The person can open it, then claim and publish the site there on the free plan. No signup or email needed to see the preview; it expires after 72 hours unless claimed. Limited to 3 previews per hour per network. Use it when someone wants to see what a website for their business could look like.

business_name.description: Optional business name. If omitted it is taken from the first phrase of the description.

city.description: Optional city or area, e.g. "Tacoma, WA".

description.description: One sentence describing the business, e.g. "Family-run wood-fired pizzeria, takeout and dine-in, since 2019."
examples: Family-run wood-fired pizzeria, takeout and dine-in, since 2019.
Licensed plumber doing emergency repairs and water heaters

name: build_site_preview
title: Build a website preview for a small business
